scope_notes: Registry for scattering phase-shift datasets for K4 delay audits.
Each entry should provide a small, vendored subset sufficient to compute a Wigner-Smith time-delay proxy.
This file may be initially empty; the corresponding audit script will output a minimal LaTeX note and exit successfully.

datasets.citation: Breit-Wigner single-resonance phase model used as a calibration benchmark (non-empirical).
notes: This dataset is a deterministic benchmark, not an experimental record.
It provides a minimal phase-shift point cloud around an isolated resonance to activate the phase->delay audit interface.

abscissa.note: Synthetic abscissa used in the Breit-Wigner benchmark (non-physical).

datasets.citation: NN-OnLine (Radboud University Nijmegen), nucleon-nucleon phase shifts, np 1S0, PWA93, tabular output (accessed 2026-01-11).
notes: Public partial-wave analysis output (not a raw detector stream).
Input was generated via NN-OnLine 'phase shifts versus energy: number' with Tlab in MeV and phase shift in degrees; values are stored here in radians.

abscissa.note: Laboratory kinetic energy coordinate used by NN-OnLine tabular output for NN phase shifts.
